answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. Tending a river, watching a reef, and naming a ferrous is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
